OUR APPROACH

Precise inputs.
Honest interpretations.

Vedik explores the traditions of Vedic astrology. Its readings are interpretations for reflection, not scientifically established forecasts.

What this beta calculates

Geocentric planetary positions from Astronomy Engine, an approximate Lahiri sidereal adjustment, mean lunar nodes and whole-sign houses. Dates from 1900–2100 and latitudes within ±65° are supported.

Reference validation is pending. This beta is not yet a high-precision astrology calculator. Boundary-sensitive signs and ascendants should be independently checked.

What “strongest” means

We rank a small set of transparent rules by matching placement, angular house, own sign and exaltation sign. These scores are not probabilities. Readings do not yet incorporate aspects, dashas, transits or divisional charts and make no timed-event claims.

Your privacy

Birth inputs are used in browser memory only. No profile is saved or sent to a prediction service. Downloading exports your chart to your device.

Built on Astronomy Engine. Calculation reference: Swiss Ephemeris.
